description.en: Temporary, context-inheriting side chats in the right sidebar: opens an independent root session with the current conversation's completed turns as read-only prompt context, keeps its own transcript, model, permissions and usage, hides it from the ordinary session list, and stops and archives it when its tab closes.
description.zh: 右侧栏的临时、上下文继承侧边聊天：以当前会话已完成回合作为只读提示上下文创建独立根会话，拥有自己的对话、模型、权限与用量，不出现在普通会话列表，关闭标签时停止并归档。
